info.name: Admin — Notification Groups
info.description:
CRUD for the admin notification-groups endpoint. All requests require a Bearer token obtained from POST /api/admin/auth/login.

Set the collection variable `base_url` to your app URL (e.g. http://localhost) and `admin_token` to the token returned by the login endpoint.

**Implementation Details:**
- Uses standard Laravel notifications (database + Firebase FCM)
- Notifications are queued via SendGroupNotificationJob
- notification_group_id stored in notifications.data JSON column
- Supports translatable title and body (en/ar)
- Status flow: pending → sending → sent (or failed)
- Only pending notifications can be deleted

query.description: Items per page (omit or set paginate=false for full list)
Set to false to return all without pagination
Search in title (en/ar) and body (en/ar) using LIKE
Filter by status: pending, sending, sent, failed

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of notification groups with creator info and recipient count.

**Filters:**
- `search`: Searches in title (en/ar) and body (en/ar) using LIKE pattern
- `status`: Filter by status (pending, sending, sent, failed)
- `order_by`: Sort by column (default: created_at)
- `order_direction`: Sort direction (asc/desc, default: desc)

response.name: 200 OK — paginated list

request.description:
Creates a notification group and immediately dispatches it to the queue (SendGroupNotificationJob). The group is sent via both database and Firebase FCM channels.

**Notes:**
- `title` and `body` are translatable — both `en` and `ar` are required.
- `user_ids` must be an array of existing user IDs (min 1, no duplicates).
- The job is queued; status starts as `pending` then transitions to `sending` → `sent` (or `failed`).
- Firebase FCM is sent per-user using the user's locale if available.
